description: This file implements low-level backup and restore functionality for the Android /data partition, including directory traversal, file copying, and system commands to stop and start system services.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for backup or restore operation, parsing command-line arguments, stopping/starting system services, and invoking backup or restore functions.

methods.name: backup_data
methods.description: Performs a backup of the /data directory to a specified file, traversing directories and files, and writing metadata and contents.

methods.name: restore_data
methods.description: Restores the /data directory from a backup file, recreating directories and files, and restoring metadata.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and command options for the backup/restore utility.
